beats.vo: If your baby wakes the second you put them down, you didn't create a bad habit.
beats.caption: It's not a bad habit.

beats.vo: Newborns can't regulate their own temperature or heartbeat yet. Your body does it for them.
beats.caption: Your body regulates theirs.

beats.vo: So when you lay them on a cold, flat mattress, their nervous system says: danger. And they wake.
beats.caption: Cold surface = danger.

beats.vo: Here's the gentle fix. Three steps.
beats.caption: The 3-step transfer.

beats.vo: One. Linger. After they fall asleep, wait three more minutes before you move.
beats.caption: 1. Linger 3 minutes.

beats.vo: Two. Lower them bottom-first, with your hand on their chest.
beats.caption: 2. Bottom-first.

beats.vo: Three. Keep that gentle pressure for thirty seconds before you let go.
beats.caption: 3. Stay 30 seconds.

beats.vo: The step everyone skips is the lingering. That's the one that works.
beats.caption: Don't skip the linger.

beats.vo: Comment SLEEP and I'll send you the full three-step guide, free.
beats.caption: Comment SLEEP
